main.description: One one-time prekey. The owner deletes the record after the prekey is first used. Another sender may race for the same prekey; that sender falls back to X3DH without a one-time prekey.

deviceId.description: Signal device id of the device that owns this prekey.

publicKey.description: libsignal-serialized public key of this one-time prekey.

formatVersion.description: Version of this app's record encoding, independent of the libsignal version.
